title: BONUM EST IN QUOD TENDIT APPETITUS.
html_source:
Also from Latin (unsurprisingly at this point…),
The good is in that toward which the appetite tends

anchor.text: BONUM EST IN QUOD TENDIT APPETITUS.
anchor.prefix:
eye. Will it therefore be beautiful?

 —In so far as it is apprehended by the sight, which I suppose means here esthetic intellection, it will be beautiful. But Aquinas also says
anchor.suffix:
In so far as it satisfies the animal craving for warmth fire is a good. In hell, however, it is an evil.

 —Quite so, said the dean, you have certainly hit the nail on the head.
anchor.canonical_text: Bonum est in quod tendit appetitus.
